title: Bride and Groom
author: litcyz
description:
Bride and Groom Embroidery Designs for Embroidery Machine (3 Size)
Capture the romance of the big day with this stunning Bride & Groom Wedding Sketch embroidery design. Rendered in a sophisticated, minimalist fine-line style, this motif depicts a tender moment between a couple, featuring a bride in a flowing, floor-length gown and a groom in a classic tuxedo. The airy, sketch-like quality of the linework gives it a timeless, hand-drawn feel that is perfect for high-end wedding projects.
It’s an ideal choice for personalizing wedding handkerchiefs, bridal robe backs, decorative ring bearer pillows, or anniversary wall art. With its light stitch count and elegant aesthetic, this design adds a touch of couture-inspired grace to any fabric.
